zh-CN.title: JZDXQ 小程序能力补全
items: 通讯录新增空间成员与在线成员视图，好友、申请和群聊变化会及时安静同步
足迹地图补全一对一授权与共同足迹，聊天中可以直接分享、查看和管理足迹
广场发布会提示额度与媒体权限，匿名发言作者也可选择匿名或公开评论
聊天文件支持从云端资源快速选择，表情探索与常用列表会优先读取缓存

en.title: JZDXQ Mini Program parity completed
items: Contacts now includes space-wide and online member views, with quiet refreshes for friendship and group changes
Footprints now covers one-to-one access and shared maps that open directly from chat
Square explains quotas and media access, while anonymous authors can choose anonymous or public comments
Chat files can be selected from cloud resources, and sticker lists now render from cache first
